params.panel_rule: Panel(X) = {X, SPY member, IWM member}; SPY member = SPY from 1993-01-29 else ^GSPC x factor; IWM member = IWM from 2000-05-26 else ^RUT x factor; each member carries the production votes on its own closes
params.signals: production votes on each panel member's own price closes: close > SMA200; 252-session price return > 0; close > 126-session max/min midpoint

selection.rule: arms passing G1-G9 + AT (after-tax $100k, all three windows) + B1 + B2 + F3; selected = highest after-tax liquidated CAGR at $100k on the 2000 window
